description: Build a threat model for a planned feature, design, or component by identifying assets, actors, entry points, and trust boundaries, enumerating threats with STRIDE, and ranking mitigations, before or alongside implementation. Use when the user asks for a threat model, a security design review, abuse cases, or "what could go wrong" security analysis of a design or feature. Do not use for auditing existing code for vulnerabilities (use kit-security-audit), for mapping the entry points of existing code (use kit-attack-surface), or for general design trade-offs without a security focus; this skill reports and does not edit code.
